scripts.pre-commit: npm run check && npm run ai:compact
scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm run setup
scripts.setup: node scripts/bootstrap.mjs && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run check
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace=@workspace/web" "npm run dev --workspace=@workspace/api"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
